full_judgment: 2. Short facts relevant for the purpose of the case are that opposite party Nos. 1 & 2 as plaintiffs instituted on 24.7.90 a suit in the Court of the Senior Assistant Judge Muradnagar being Title Suit No. 44 of 1990, praying for partition of the suit property by metes and bounds on declaration of title in 30 decimals of land out of 68 decimals of land in suit plot No. 162, previously under Madan No. 12 and Khatian No. 137 of Mouza Nagarpur under Muradnagar Police Station, on the basis of a deed of gift and by way of inheritance. The said suit was eventually decreed ex-parte on 30.5.91. Thereafter defendant No. 4 Ansar Ali (who is opposite party No. 3 before this Court) filed an application under Order 9 Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure for setting aside the ex-parte decree dated 6.6.92, following which Miscellaneous Case No. 13 of 1992 was started and the learned Assistant Judge by his impugned order dated 29.10.92 eventually allowed the said case and set aside the ex-parte decree dated 6.6.92 and restoring the suit to its original file and number. Thereafter the petitioner purchased 11 decimals of the suit land from defendant Nos. 1 by 2 separate sale deeds dated 18.7.1991 and duly got into possession in the suit property. Thereafter the present petitioners got their names mutated in respect of the suit property and they have been owning and possessing it on payment of rent in their names to the appropriate authority.
